Which quote is cheaper, and by how much?

The **[Small deductible plan](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaHmCAI/view)** is cheaper at **$139,035** a year, which is **$10,465** less than [Guaranteed cost](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaHlCAI/view) at $149,500.

| Quote | Annual premium | Deductible | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small deductible plan | $139,035 | $2,500 | $1,000,000 |
| Guaranteed cost | $149,500 | $0 | $1,000,000 |

Both quotes are with the customer and valid until 20 Oct. The cheaper plan saves about 7% on premium, but Ironwood would pay a $2,500 deductible. [Option 3](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaODCAY/view) is still a draft and has no premium yet, so I couldn't compare it.
